payload.title: Clarify portfolio phases when no optimization targets run
payload.description:
Observed behavior: a portfolio run with no approved optimization targets still publishes optimization and optimization-review milestones using active-work language. This implies optimizer or evaluation work is running when those phases are actually empty.

Feature: Truthful empty optimization phase narration

Scenario: No approved targets enter optimization
Given a portfolio run has zero approved optimization targets
When the run publishes the optimization milestone
Then the Report states that no optimizations were launched
And the next checkpoint does not imply evaluations are running

Scenario: No optimizer results enter review
Given a portfolio run has no dispatched optimizer procedures or evaluation evidence
When the run publishes the optimization-review milestone
Then the Report states that there are no optimization results to review
And does not imply completed optimizer evidence exists

Scenario: Approved targets are dispatched
Given one or more exact targets were approved and dispatched
When optimization and review milestones are published
Then active-work narration remains specific to the dispatched work

Out of scope: changing approval authority, optimizer dispatch, evaluation behavior, or terminal status.
